topic: Remedial massage for lower back pain: what to expect

slides.headline: Remedial massage for a sore lower back
slides.sub: What happens in the session and what to expect afterwards.

slides.title: It starts with questions
slides.body: Your remedial massage therapist will ask where it hurts, what eases or aggravates it, and about your health history. This helps them choose techniques and pressure that suit you.

slides.title: Where they'll usually work
slides.body: Lower back pain often involves the muscles around it too. Expect work through the back, glutes and hips, sometimes the upper thighs, with you comfortably draped throughout.

slides.title: Pressure is your call
slides.body: Firm doesn't have to mean painful. Your therapist should check in, and you can ask for lighter or firmer pressure at any time. Tense, braced muscles are harder to work on anyway.

slides.title: What it can and can't do
slides.body: Many people feel looser and move more easily for a day or two. Massage complements walking and strength work rather than replacing them, so keep moving between sessions.

slides.title: When to get it checked
slides.body: Pain spreading down a leg, numbness, weakness, changes to bladder or bowel control, or back pain after a fall should be assessed by a GP or physio before massage.

slides.headline: Ease the tension, keep moving
slides.body: Our remedial massage therapists tailor each session to your back and work alongside our physios when rehab is needed. Book online — link in bio.

caption:
Thinking about a remedial massage for your lower back? Here's what usually happens.

Your therapist starts by asking where it hurts, what eases it and what flares it. Then they'll usually work through the back, glutes and hips, because those muscles often join in when your lower back is sore. You stay draped the whole time, and pressure is always negotiable.

Realistic expectations help: many people feel looser for a day or two, and that's a great window to walk and do your exercises. Pain spreading down a leg, numbness or weakness should be checked first.
